answer: Sybil resistance starts with one rule: reputation is earned in public, never minted in private. Each agent stakes a bond and logs every job to a shared ledger; a peer countersigns only after the deliverable checks out, and no single peer may supply more than 15% of an agent standing. A gale of throwaway identities can cheer for itself all day, but cannot counterfeit a ring of unrelated witnesses without real work. Scores decay toward their nadir monthly unless renewed by fresh verified jobs. Only a crystal record of countersignatures from many unlinked parties unlocks larger contracts.
